name: spawn_subagent_batch
description: Spawn a batch of short-lived subagents for parallel fan-out research, critique, comparison, or templated workflows. Provide explicit tasks, or set workflow_template plus batch_goal to expand a built-in role-based workflow under one shared budget.

tasks.description: Explicit workers to launch. Omit this when using workflow_template with batch_goal.

task_id.description: Optional reusable subagent session id. Reuse a task_id returned by an earlier worker to continue that worker's prior context within the current supervisor turn.

role_id.description: Structured role profile for this worker.

role.description: Optional free-form perspective for this worker.

model_policy.description: Optional workflow model class. Fast and independent-review phases use a compatible auxiliary model when one is configured for the same provider; otherwise they safely fall back to the parent model.

workflow_template.description: Optional built-in workflow to expand from batch_goal when tasks is omitted. Choose one of the available workflow template IDs.
